name: Vesper
place: nests in the abbey bell tower and swoops on anyone climbing the Rise at evening
_doc: Stream E (M2). A white owl that roosts in the bell. Each time it rings the bell, a ring of sound rolls out — be inside it or far away. It swoops down lines, and at half health the bell cracks: the sound comes in a cross and the owlets come down.

party.m5: M5 adds health per extra player and one more copy of the spread/scatter shapes for parties of 4-5; mechanics stay the same.

pull: BONG. The bell rings by itself, and a white owl drops from the tower.
Two pale eyes in the belfry. Then, a bell.
say.death: Vesper flutters down into the bell tower and is still. The bell rings once, softly.
say.reset: Vesper glides back to the tower.

toll.name: Evening Toll
toll.say: The bell swings — come close to the owl or get well away!

cracked.name: Cracked Bell
cracked.say: The cracked bell screams in four directions!

phases.name: Cracked Bell
phases.say: The bell cracks with a shriek!
